rows.behavior: kmctl's package ships packages/kmctl/apm/.apm/skills/decision-gaps/SKILL.md with valid front matter (name decision-gaps and a description saying when to use it); its body runs kmctl decision candidates --json, judges every change it lists, reports missing decisions with the choice, the rejected option and the change, and says it writes nothing and leaves records to the user and kmctl new decision; the wheel carries it; the briefing lists it; it judges in batches and asks to narrow a long range; it lists record-only changes apart; the two install pages count eight skills and name it.
rows.fails_when: the skill folder or front matter is missing or invalid, the body lacks one of those instructions, the wheel or the briefing leaves it out, or an install page still counts seven skills

rows.behavior: The skill was made with the skill-creator skill: evals/evals.json holds its test prompts (one asking to find unrecorded decisions, one naming a starting point, one asking to write a decision record that should not trigger it, and one known-answer range of this repository scored against .okf/prototypes/decision-gaps/results/labels.json) with expectations, and evals/results.md records each run's outcome, the known-answer run's gaps found and false alarms raised against the labels, and that no run wrote to .okf/.
rows.fails_when: evals.json is missing, malformed or lacks one of those prompt kinds or their expectations, results.md lacks a result for a prompt, the known-answer result lacks its counts against the labels, or results.md does not say whether .okf/ stayed unchanged

rows.behavior: docs/how-to/ has a page on finding unrecorded decisions that runs the skill and says the user decides; the how-to index lists it; kmctl check and the docs frontmatter tests pass.
rows.fails_when: the page or its index entry is missing, it implies the skill writes records, or kmctl check reports a finding
